answer: Pass payouts per funding tree are capped at 2 median payouts per close (E40: median 8.25M, cap 16.5M). With 3.4 % of settled rows passing (106 of 3,130), the cap binds from about 59 accounts: Timber with 60 accounts nets about 1.5 pass-equivalents, Walnut with 1,000 and Pearl with 100,000 get 2, so every account past the hundredth earns nothing more. Cheapest bypass: one exchange wallet per account, costing n on-ramp fees against about 280k expected per account; it pays while the fee is below that.
